title: Nacho Supreme
html:
Nacho Supreme
Piece:  Helm
Class:  Fighter
Defense Rating:  varies with item level

Nacho Supreme is a fighter scale.

This one came from the Wishing Well.

Manglefeet's lair chest is also wired to roll this helm. It is better known as a Wishing Well piece, and it always felt half-finished. See Boss Lair Rainbows.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Strength
  • + Melee Damage
  • + % Enemy Stun Chance
  • + % Ranged Critical Chance
  • + Mana Steal

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
